rubric.evidence: WebIDL (`readonly attribute Promise<undefined> draining;`) verified verbatim against W3C WebTransport spec and Chromium Blink web_transport.idl. Edge invariants (same-object promise accessible before ready, streams remain usable after draining, closed remains pending after draining, draining stays pending on close() without a WT_DRAIN_SESSION capsule) verified verbatim from WPT webtransport/draining.https.any.js.

Feature 6427766428925952 appears under 'Enabled by default' in /api/v0/features?milestone=158 with listing name 'WebTransport draining'; slug webtransport-draining matches listing name; H1 equals listing name; declared ChromeStatus row links https://chromestatus.com/feature/6427766428925952; Blink WebTransportDraining runtime flag is status: 'stable'.

Honest Case A MDN stub: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/WebTransport/draining returns HTTP 200 and contains complete Value, Description, Examples, Specifications, and BCD-backed Browser compatibility sections (verified 2026-11-24). Matches sibling v158 WebTransport MDN stubs while adding Chrome 158 shipping metadata, WPT invariants, and Baseline nuance.
Clearly explains server-initiated draining semantics, why draining stays pending on normal close without a drain signal, and how to feature-detect for Chrome < 158.
Includes a concise feature-detected draining snippet pointing to MDN's canonical worked examples; no Chrome Platform Showcase demo exists yet (HEAD 404 on 2026-11-24).

Transcribes exact BCD api/WebTransport.json versions (Chrome/Edge 158, Firefox 155, Safari 26.4) alongside Bugzilla 2007160, WebKit bug 302762, and the webstatus.dev Baseline nuance (parent webtransport became Newly available 2026-03-24 before Chrome 158 added draining).

Every visible source label carries a direct <a href> with target='_blank' rel='noopener' (MDN, W3C TR/ED, explainer, ChromeStatus, blink-dev Intent to Ship, crbug 564353368, Bugzilla, WebKit bug, Interop issue, WPT, BCD, webstatus.dev, Blink IDL/flags).

Single <main>, single <h1>, sequential h2 hierarchy, semantic tables with <caption> and <th scope>, focusable .table-wrap scroll regions with role='region' aria-labelledby and :focus-visible outline, and role='note' on the Baseline banner.

Minimal page-specific CSS relying on shared public/styles.css semantic tokens, logical max-inline-size: 100% on .table-wrap, browsers-as-rows compact compat table, and verified via npm run responsive at desktop and mobile viewports.

HEAD check on https://chrome-platform-showcase.paulkinlan-ea.deno.net/v158/webtransport-draining/ returned 404 on 2026-11-24; no broken showcase link or iframe emitted so manifest demo remains honestly null.
